risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (373), flat yield curve, imminent CPI event (0 days), and negative macro score (-5) create severely unfavourable conditions; utilities defensive positioning offers limited refuge in acute volatility regime.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI-9 extreme oversold (below 30) with price above 200-EMA creates textbook mean-reversion bounce setup in fear-driven market, offering asymmetric risk/reward near support at 40.19.
